name: Tree Characterization Equivalence
hypotheses: Finite connected graph; the VC-dimension and obstruction criteria assume the graph is a partial cube.
statement: Acyclicity, VC dimension at most one, and avoidance of the four-cycle as a pc-minor define the same class inside finite partial cubes.
proof: Every tree is a partial cube whose edge classes are singletons. If a partial cube contains a cycle, it contains a convex even cycle; retaining two of its coordinate classes by contraction produces $Q_2$. The cube-minor theorem identifies avoidance of $Q_2$ with VC dimension at most one.
